description: This Java source file defines a BroadcastReceiver class named SmsMessageReceiver for an Android application. Its purpose is to listen for incoming SMS messages, retrieve message details and sender information, look up the sender's display name from contacts, and then start an activity to display the received message.

classes.name: SmsMessageReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that handles incoming SMS messages, processes message and sender info, and launches a dialog activity to display the message.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles the received broadcast intent, extracts SMS message objects, retrieves sender info, looks up display names, and launches an activity to present the message.
